Baskerville42/outage-data-ua.description: A public repository of data on scheduled power outages in Ukraine.
Baskerville42/outage-data-ua.body:
# outage-data-ua

A public repository and tools for automatically collecting, parsing, visualizing (HTML), and generating PNG images of charts of scheduled and emergency power outages in Ukraine.

The project retrieves data from public web pages of power suppliers and stores it as JSON "as is" in the `data/` directory. This data is then rendered in a fixed HTML template and converted into PNG images, which are saved as `images/<region>/gpv-x-x.png`.

---

## Data format
Each region is stored in a file `data/<region>.json`. Basic structure (abbreviated):

```json
{
  "regionId": "kyiv",
  "regionAffiliation": "City of Kyiv",
  "lastUpdated": "2025-11-06T11:41:56.430Z",
  "fact": { "updateFact": "06.11.2025 09:09" },
  "preset": { "updateFact": "04.11.2025 18:00" },
  "lastUpdateStatus": { "status": "parsed", "ok": true, "code": 200, "message": null, "at": "2025-11-06T11:41:56.430Z", "attempt": 5 },
  "meta": { "schemaVersion": "1.0.0", "contentHash": "..." }
}
```

- `preset` — scheduled outages for the week for each group (weekly template). Stored "as is," without normalizing the structure.
- `fact` — actual and emergency outages for today and tomorrow for each group. Also…

# ko-design-md

**Design languages of Korean brands, condensed into a single cited DESIGN.md**

**🔗 Live catalog → [getdesign.kr](https://getdesign.kr)**

---

## What is ko-design-md?

Ask an LLM or coding agent to "make it like Toss" and the results differ every time, and they don't come out looking like that brand. The design materials brands publish are scattered across different places in inconsistent formats, so they're hard to drop directly into a context.

ko-design-md is an open catalog that condenses the design languages of Korean brands (colors, typography, spacing, components, principles) into one **DESIGN.md** per brand. Every entry follows the same format, so people can read them side by side and agents can take them and use them as they are. You can see which brands are included at [getdesign.kr](https://getdesign.kr).

## Using it right away

### 1. Copy from the site

Pick a brand on [getdesign.kr](https://getdesign.kr), then press the **Copy full DESIGN.md** button on the detail page, or download it as a file and paste it into the chat or IDE you're using. No sign-up or installation is required.

### 2. Attach it to a coding agent as a skill — `use-design-md`

The [`use-design-md` skill](https://github.com/CaesiumY/ko-design-md/blob/HEAD/.claude/skills/use-design-md/SKILL.md) takes only a brand name, finds that brand's DESIGN.md in the catalog, and applies the design language to the UI of **the project you're working on now**. It only reads the catalog, so it works in any repository. (It is the opposite of the `/design-md` skill, which creates new entries.)

**All agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini, etc.) — [skills.sh](https://skills.sh)**

```bash
npx skills add CaesiumY/ko-design-md          # install the use-design-md skill
```

ColdP/HyperChanger.body:
## Project Overview

HyperChanger is an LSPosed module for Xiaomi HyperOS 4. Through a companion app, it configures the appearance and behavior of the system interface, notifications and Control Center, lock screen, launcher, system settings, back screen, and supported apps. The module requires root permission and modifies existing components through hooks.

The current source version is **1.2.0 RC2**; refer to the `versionName` in [app/build.gradle.kts](https://github.com/ColdP/HyperChanger/blob/HEAD/app/build.gradle.kts). For download versions and release notes, see [Releases](https://github.com/ColdP/HyperChanger/releases).

The project is still in the testing stage and is mainly adapted for **HyperOS 4 (Android 17)**. Differences in devices, regions, system builds, and app versions may affect functionality; the minimum supported install version does not mean all features are supported.

## Features

### Notifications, Control Center, and Volume Panel

- Separately adjust the notification center and Control Center backgrounds, and the material, blur, opacity, and corner radius of elements such as regular notifications, media notifications, and focus notifications.
- iOS-style notification center: rounded wallpaper panel, lock screen clock, and depth-of-field effect; optionally show the lock screen wallpaper or no wallpaper, hide the clear button, and adjust the notification bottom offset. Live wallpapers are not currently supported.
- Customize the large Control Center clock, date spacing, red "1", carrier text and network indicator, and the height of the top area.
- Adjust the volume panel's blur, glass intensity, background opacity, and corner radius.
- Use built-in or user presets, and share notification and Control Center configurations via JSON or QR code.

### Super Island, Status Bar, and Gesture Hint Bar

- Adjust Super Island width, spacing between large and small islands, smooth outline in collapsed state, and background material.
- Remove some focus notification and Super Island whitelist restrictions, adjust notification backgrounds and media cards, and provide simulation of regular, focus, and media notifications.
- Customize the status bar's two-row signal, network type text, icon display, scaling, position, and spacing.
- Adjust the style and size of the global gesture hint bar.

### Lock Screen, Music, and Wallpaper

- Adjust lock screen clock, horizontal position, depth of field, charging text, bottom shortcuts, fingerprint icon, and passcode input appearance.
- Customize the lock screen editor background, template count limit, lock screen capsule, and face unlock Super Island; provides linkage between Amap (Gaode Maps) navigation and the lock screen capsule.
- Edit lock screen widgets: combine weather, battery, sunrise/sunset, steps, alarm, schedule, and signature images, with sorting and layout, color, and material adjustments.
- Music lock screen cover, mini player, and lyrics display; local lyrics can be managed in the lyrics library.
- Configure a fun raster live wallpaper and export the current home screen and lock screen wallpapers.
- Keep the soft glass effect after applying a global app theme, and remove the OTA conversion restriction on the screen-off clock glass and overlay materials.

### Launcher and Recents

- Add a Dock to the compatible HyperOS 4 Rust launcher, supporting solid colors, advanced materials, soft glass, and entrance animations.

## iOS App Maintenance

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
npx cap sync ios
npx cap open ios
```

Then select iPhone in Xcode and press `Cmd + R` to install.

XiaMo233M/Stronghold-Protocol-Forge.body:
# Stronghold-Protocol-Forge · Stronghold Protocol Workshop Editor

An **unofficial fan recreation** of the Arknights seasonal auto-chess tower defense mode “Stronghold Protocol: Alliance”: playable instantly in the browser, solo or 1–4 player co-op.

This repository consists of three parts:

- **Forge Workshop Editor** (`editor/`, the main focus of this repository): a graphical tool that lives **outside the game** and is used to create its content (operators, maps, monsters, enemy waves, equipment, alliances, behavior-layer kits, voice lines), then export finished packs as a `.zip` to share with others. It has nine pages, is bilingual in Chinese and English, and **does not exist unless you run it**.
- **Mod layer** (`shared/workshop.js` etc.): the part of the engine that **packs can reach**. It is a **closed set** of 35 top-level keys, 9 UI slots, 6 server-side module purposes, 4 rewritable UI components, pack channels, calibration axes, **a 4-slot behavior switch**, asset sources, dynamic routing, announcement surfaces, trait-granted alliances, target hosts (`target`), and dependency and mutual-exclusion resolution between packs. **Packs can only consume channels that already exist in this layer**; they cannot change the engine itself.
- **Upstream fan game** (Stronghold Protocol: Alliance · upstream **0.2.5**): where the content written by the editor ultimately runs. It is included in this repository.

A pack travels from `pack.json` to other people through the **standard pack specification** (`docs/STANDARD-PACK.md`), the **mod repository** (`Stronghold-Protocol-Forge-Mods`), and the **submission site** (`site/`). This pipeline works today; see [From submission to inclusion](#投稿到入库).

The code is released under **GPL-3.0-or-later**. It has **no affiliation** with Shanghai Hypergryph Network Technology Co., Ltd. (Hypergryph), Yostar, or their affiliates.

# IMBoy Backend [English](https://github.com/imboy-pub/imboy/blob/HEAD/README.en.md) IMBoy is a privately deployable instant messaging platform. This repository contains the Erlang/OTP backend, database migrations, production deployment configuration, and product documentation. The Flutter client and React admin console are in separate repositories. ## What it can do Phase 1 delivery (`phase1_delivery` profile) capability scope: - One-to-one and group chat, and message push (Core IM: contacts, history/offline/multi-device sync, attachments and message governance) - Enterprise organizations/departments/members/workspaces and RBAC; human customer-service agents and visitor Widget; OA integration (internal API / SSO / Webhook) - Channel foundation (the organization's internal General group and announcement channels) - Moments and nearby people (Phase 1 scope; publishing, interactions, location, and privacy controls must be accepted against the delivery matrix) - HTTP API and WebSocket long connections - PostgreSQL persistence and direct upload of attachments to Garage S3 - Docker Compose single-node production deployment (Helm/Kubernetes is experimental and not validated on a production cluster) The full version (full-selected) also includes domains such as channel discovery/invitations/paid channels, E2EE end-to-end encryption, RTC, Bots, and an AI assistant. Under the Phase 1 delivery profile, these domains are turned off by delivery locks and fail-closed gates, and stale caches or remote configuration cannot re-enable them. For phase boundaries, allowlists, and the delivery lock list, see the [packaging contract](https://github.com/imboy-pub/imboy/blob/HEAD/docs/product/packaging-contract.md). skyfireitdiy/Jarvis.body:
# Jarvis AI Assistant

> ## 🏆 Grand Champion of the 3rd OpenAtom Open Source Competition
>
> **Grand Champion of the "智锻代码·开源鸿蒙全球 AI Agent 代码生成挑战赛" (Zhiduan Code · Open-Source HarmonyOS Global AI Agent Code Generation Challenge)**
>
> - 🤖 **Over 10,000 Agent self-bootstrapped commits**: 5,795 in 2025 + 4,524 in 2026, **over 99% completed autonomously by CodeAgent**
> - 📦 **Project size**: 319 Python files, 158,181 lines of code, 84 test files, 1,064 test cases (v5.0.1)

## Moving Agents from "Working Alone" to "Working Together" 🚀

**In one sentence**: a locally run, ready-to-use, deeply customizable **collaborative AI development platform**. It fully covers four collaboration modes ("one person, one Agent", "one person, multiple Agents", "multiple people, one Agent", "multiple people, multiple Agents"), and handles code writing, review, automation, security analysis, and C→Rust migration, all from one command line.

[Why Jarvis](#-为什么选-jarvis) · [Collaboration Modes](#协作模式四象限) · [Access Methods](#-访问方式) · [Core Capabilities](#-核心能力) · [Quick Start](#-快速开始) · [Common Commands](#-常用命令) · [Python SDK](#-python-sdk-集成) · [Configuration](#-配置说明) · [Extensions](#-扩展能力) · [Local Background Service (jarvis-daemon)](#-本地后台服务jarvis-daemon) · [Browser Extension (browser-bridge)](#-浏览器扩展browser-bridge) · [Contributing](#-贡献指南)

---

## 👋 What is Jarvis?

Jarvis is a **collaborative AI development platform** for developers. It is not just a chat tool. It works inside your workflow: reading code, modifying code, executing tools, managing context, reusing experience, and staying controllable at key checkpoints.

Its core premise is: **moving Agents from "working alone" to "working together"**. The collaboration capabilities of AI development tools can be analyzed along two intersecting dimensions: **the human dimension** (one person vs. multiple people) and **the Agent dimension** (single vs. multiple Agents). Crossing them yields four collaboration modes, and Jarvis covers all four.

If you want AI to do more than "give advice", and instead help you **analyze, execute, verify, and accumulate experience** in your local environment, Jarvis is designed for exactly that scenario.

### Who is it for?

- Individual developers who want to bring AI into their daily development workflow
- Engineering teams who want to unify code change, review, and verification processes
- Users with specialized needs for security analysis, automation, and C→Rust migration
- Users who want to keep local control and avoid deep lock-in to a single platform

taxueseek/fund-investment-guide.body:
# Invest Series: Investment Analysis Guide

Buying a fund is like hiring a steward; buying stocks is like going into business as a partner. People who don't understand, people who aren't reliable, and people who charge too much cannot be entrusted with your money.

This tool helps you with three things: **see clearly what you are investing in, judge whether it is worth investing in, and determine whether the price is reasonable**.

**Supports 17 data sources (APIs) and 11 analysis methodologies**:
- **Data sources**: no-key sources (Tencent Quotes / SEC EDGAR / FRED / yfinance) + configurable sources (Tonghuashun / East Money / Miaoxiang / FMP / Tiingo / Wind / Yingmi / Tiantian Fund official ttskill) + long-tail capabilities (Tencent Micro Securities, 40+ subcommands)
- **Methodologies**: covering individual stocks, funds, fund selection, single assets (bonds / convertible bonds / commodities / REITs), asset allocation, risk management, in-depth company analysis, macro environment, institutional-grade outputs, and multi-perspective consultation

---

## Quick install: enter the command below to get started

```bash
npx skills add taxueseek/fund-investment-guide
```

After installing, ask Claude directly:
- "How is this fund?"
- "Analyze Moutai"
- "Can I buy gold?"
- "Let the masters take a look at this stock"

The system automatically identifies what you want to analyze and enters the corresponding analysis workflow.

> **Note**: This tool only helps you organize your thinking. It is not investment advice and does not guarantee profit. After analysis, whether or not to buy is your own decision.

---

## Supported data sources (APIs)

After installation you can use the **judgment framework** right away. It works without configuring any API (public search + materials you provide + no-key data channels). There are **17 data sources** in total (the table below lists the common ones), divided into three tiers by how they are enabled. Data retrieval and judgment are kept separate.

### No key (works on install)

| Data source | Enabled capabilities |
|:-------|:---------|
| **Tencent Quotes** (zero auth) | `invest-cli quote` multi-symbol real-time quotes, `kline` candlesticks; A-shares / HK / US stocks / ETFs / convertible bonds |
| **SEC EDGAR** | `invest-cli sec` US stock filings original text (10-K XBRL + filing list) |
| **FRED** | `invest-cli intent macro` net liquidity, three series (no-key via CSV channel) |
| **yfinance** (Python package) | `invest-cli us` US stock snapshot (quotes + financials + ratings) |

### Enabled after configuration

| Data source | Configuration | Enabled capabilities |
|:-------|:-------|:---------|
| **Tonghuashun Financial Data Service** | `HITHINK_FINANCE_API_KEY` | `stock` / `fund` A-share and public fund main path (fast, full fields) |
| **East Money** |…
